Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Industrial Wood and Metal Dining Room Kitchen Table, 86.6"L, Fir
Colors: Natural+black Iron
Materials: Wood
86.6"L x 37.4"D x 29.8"H 50% recycled fir wood; iron base with black finish A handsome piece that blends with modern, rustic or industrial decor Assembly required. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty. Vintage wood shop and industrial metal-working come together in this head-turning dining table. Simple, beautiful style and sturdy construction -- 50% from recycled materials -- make it a handsome asset to a rustic, modern or industrial setting.
